resources.string:
TimeOS reconstructs how you actually spend your day by reading which apps are in the foreground and for how long — the same information Android's own Digital Wellbeing screen uses.

Usage Access lets TimeOS see app names and timestamps only. It cannot see message content, contacts, notifications, passwords, screenshots, or what you type. Everything stays on this device unless you later choose to sync it to your own server.

This permission cannot be granted from a normal pop-up — Android requires it to be turned on from a dedicated settings screen.
Look for \"TimeOS\" in the list and turn it on.
